status: candidate; loaded only when the candidate letter model is switched on in the page; not the default model
coordinates: y scaled by image height / width before normalization, as letterFeatures() does
license: Image-set samples: no license specified in the source dataset card at download time. ASL-HG samples: CC BY 4.0, see additionalReferences.
split: fit split only (seed-42 test and seed-17 validation images excluded); plus ASL-HG reference signers

selection.maxDistanceRule: 99th percentile of the nearest-reference distance over validation rows labelled correctly with the gate open

additionalReferences.source: ASL-HG: American Sign Language Hand Gesture Image Dataset, Mendeley Data, version 1, DOI 10.17632/j4y5w2c8w9.1, CC BY 4.0
additionalReferences.authors: Pranto, Islam, Akbor, Ghosh, Alam, Chaki, Islam (Bangladesh University of Business and Technology)
additionalReferences.changes: Hand landmarks were extracted from the photographs with MediaPipe and normalized; no image is included.

digitClasses.note: 0, 2, 6 and 9 are not classes: they share the handshape of O, V, W and F
